title: Socle du Monde (<base>)
summary: The invisible HTML <base> element is Manzoni's inverted plinth: one tag the whole world of relative links stands on.
mechanism: A single <base href> governs live URL resolution of every relative link (read via a.href, never navigated); removing the tag re-resolves the world back to the document's own location.
references: Piero Manzoni, Socle du Monde / Base of the World (1961)
the HTML <base> element (net.art: browser plumbing as material)
